step_by_step_reasoning:
The architecture diagram depicts JFrog's SaaS platform deployment on AWS and how customers (public or private via AWS PrivateLink and Direct Connect) connect to it.

1. External / On-Premises & Customer VPC Nodes (Left of dashed line):
   - 'ON PREMISES' (OnPremDC) connects via an arrow to 'DIRECT CONNECT' (DirectConnect).
   - 'DIRECT CONNECT' (DirectConnect) connects to 'PROD' (EC2).
   - 'TRANSIT GATEWAY' (TransitGateway) and 'PROD' (EC2) both connect via arrows to 'VPC ENDPOINT' (PrivateLink).

2. JFrog SaaS Account Nodes (Right of dashed line):
   - Public entry: 'jfrog.io' / Globe (UserConsumerWeb) connects to 'PUBLIC NLB' (NLB).
   - 'PUBLIC NLB' (NLB) routes traffic to 'EKS' (EKS).
   - Private entry: 'VPC ENDPOINT' (PrivateLink) connects across the boundary to 'VPC PRIVATELINK' (PrivateLink).
   - 'VPC PRIVATELINK' (PrivateLink) routes traffic to 'PRIVATE NLB' (NLB).
   - 'PRIVATE NLB' (NLB) routes traffic to 'EKS' (EKS).
   - 'EKS' (EKS) accesses metadata in 'RDS' (RDS).
   - 'RDS' (RDS) connects/references binary layers stored in 'S3' (S3).
